message: バイラス

name: Virus
message: 「It's rare for you to reach out to me」

name: Melphas
message: 「A lovely lady asked me to act as an intermediary, you see」
What Melilot-san had been reluctant to do was contact Melphas.
Apparently, she'd had his email address forced on her at some point.

name: Virus
message: 「I see」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for tonight... I wasn't sure you'd come」

name: Virus
message: 「I could hardly refuse an invitation from the Demon King」
Virus gave a faint smile.
He seemed remarkably rational.

name: Virus
message: 「It appears I wasn't mistaken」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Virus
message: 「They say the first and greatest Demon King always sought to understand his opponent's wishes before battle, avoiding every fight that could be avoided」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know that...?」

name: Virus
message: 「Surprised?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes... honestly」

name: Virus
message: 「Are you surprised that I know Re-Crea means destruction, too?」
For a moment, I lost my voice and stared at Virus.

name: Melphas
message: 「Even I was aware of that much. It is hardly surprising」

name: Synn
message: 「...Then why? Are you also trying to, just like Azel in the past, use God to--」

name: Virus
message: 「I couldn't care less about God」

name: Synn
message: 「What...?」

name: Virus
message: 「I simply needed the worst possible Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea means annihilation!」

name: Virus
message: 「That's of no consequence」

name: Synn
message: 「'Of no consequence'...?」
Virus looked straight at me.

name: Virus
message: 「Have you ever wondered why the Demon Lord appears?」

name: Synn
message: 「What...?」

name: Virus
message: 「Throughout history, the Demon Lord has appeared alongside Re-Crea and saved the world time and again. The Demon Lord and Re-Crea are always a pair. And the scale of Re-Crea is directly proportional to the Demon Lord's strength.」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know something like that?」
I wouldn't have been surprised if those same words had come from Melilot's mouth.
However, they hardly sounded like something the battle-crazed demon standing before me would say.

name: Virus
message: 「Because I investigated. Every single record I could get my hands on regarding the Demon Lord.」
A glint of madness lurked in Virus's eyes as he looked at me.

name: Melphas
message: 「Ah, I see. So that is how it is.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Just as I pursue women, Virus, you pursue worthy foes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Worthy foes?」

name: Virus
message: 「The Demon Lord is a counter-reaction to Re-Crea. I believe the Demon Lord is a manifestation of the world's own will, striving to oppose Re-Crea and protect itself.」

name: Synn
message: 「So... the strength of Re-Crea and the Demon Lord are proportional...」

name: Virus
message: 「For the strongest Demon Lord, the most catastrophic Re-Crea is required.」
A single answer flashed through my mind.

name: Synn
message: 「No way! You did all of this just to fight the strongest Demon Lord?! Just to create your ultimate opponent?!」
Virus laughed. With pure delight.

name: Melphas
message: 「One might call it a maddening passion.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what you want?! You orchestrated everything for something like that?!」

name: Virus
message: 「O Demon Lord. When the power of Re-Crea reaches its peak, will you do battle with me?」
It was just a little before Azel was set to appear.
What if I refused? No, I didn't even need to think about it.
This was a man who wouldn't hesitate to drive the world to the brink of ruin just to fight me.
He wouldn't even put it past himself to take the academy's students hostage.
I wanted everyone to enjoy the Holy Night Festival as if nothing were wrong.
Besides, if I couldn't even defeat the strongest demon right in front of me, there was no way I could save the world.
I had no choice but to fight.

name: Synn
message: 「Can I choose the location?」

name: Virus
message: 「As long as we get to fight, I have no objections.」
As the Student Council President, I couldn't leave the academy.
In that case, an open space on campus where we can keep people away at that hour.

name: Synn
message: 「...In front of the church at Ryuusei Academy」

name: Virus
message: 「No problem.」
Virus smiled innocently.
It looked just like the expression on Sengen'in-sensei's face in Azel's photo.
Ah, so these people are just kids, I thought.
